text:
Maria: quick heads-up — reproduced perf noise when enabling batch-slicing + aggressive KV sharding on 8xA100 (TP=2, PP=1) across two racks. tail latency spikes ~3x under sustained qps.
AJ: ugh, can you paste the profile output?
Maria: attached summary below. main symptom: increased all-reduce calls per request after slice + shard, and interleaved small kernels that prevent comm/compute overlap.
Ciro: that matches what we saw earlier with micro-batching — fragmentation of gradients into many small allreduces kills EFA latency due to setup overhead. NVLink node-local still fine.
Sam: do we have flamegraphs? I want to see if kernel selection is picking GEMM variants that are short and frequent vs longer fused kernels.
Maria: flame snippet (trimmed):

```
53%  runtime  allreduce_wait
22%  runtime  small_gemm_variant_x8
12%  runtime  kv_prefetch_rpc
8%   runtime  cuda_memcpy_async
5%   other
```

Maria: also saw repeated tiny NCCL ops (<= 256KB) with high variance on EFA path.
AJ: can you run a trace with NCCL_DEBUG=INFO and our comm-window counter? maybe the batching heuristics are slicing batches without growing the comm window.
Maria: did that, sample trace attached. key lines: `comm_window=128`, `slice_size=16`, `allreduce_calls=24/request` for a seq_len=2048 request.
Ciro: so each slice triggers its own allreduce. we should either coalesce slices into a single allreduce window or use async allreduce + overlap.
Sam: idea: change kernel selection to prefer fused attention+gemm when comm_window <= threshold; current kernel picker only considers local memory pressure and seq_len, not comm_window.
AJ: agree. another lever: increase SCHED_COMM_WINDOW to 1024 for cross-node paths so slices are bundled. but that could hurt memory footprint on node-local.
Maria: exactly — tradeoff. on NVLink-only runs we can keep small windows; on EFA path we need coalescing. need topology-aware heuristic.
Ciro: also noticed that KV prefetch timing overlaps with allreduce setup causing extra stalls. if prefetch issues RPC before allreduce start, it serializes. we should reorder: kickoff async allreduce then prefetch.
perf-bot: perf regression detected on branch `batch-slice-2026` vs `main` — 2.8x tail on cross-node E2E test (seq=2048, batch=8).
AJ: next steps:
- Maria: produce minimal repro script and trace tarball.
- Ciro: prototype comm coalescing patch (aggregate slices into 1 NCCL op when cross-node).
- Sam: update kernel picker to include `comm_window` in cost model; simple threshold first.
- I'll set up canary on dedicated infra (2 racks) with SCHED_COMM_WINDOW env toggles.
Maria: I'll drop the repro and trace in #eng-runtime-artifacts by EOD.
Ciro: one more note — PCIe-only machines show intermediate behavior; NVLink hides the issue (allreduce latencies << rpc overhead). so our heuristic must be fabric-aware (nvlink vs pcie vs efa).
Sam: +1. Also add a unit perf test that simulates many small allreduces to prevent regressions.
AJ: cool. assign owners and we'll sync tomorrow at 11. :thumbsup:
Maria: thanks, logging this as follow-up RFC in docs repo after we validate.
perf-bot: linked issue created: #INF-4921 (aggregate-batch-slicing-comm-windowing).
